# MedicineNet

> > Doctor-produced health and medical information covering diseases, medications, procedures, and wellness guidance for patients and health-conscious individuals.

MedicineNet is a comprehensive medical reference resource owned by WebMD that provides peer-reviewed health information, diagnostic guides, medication references, and lifestyle wellness content. The site combines authoritative medical knowledge with accessible patient education across diseases, treatments, fitness, nutrition, and preventive health.

## Key Topics

- Cancer
- Heart Disease
- Heart Failure
- Diabetes
- Atrial Fibrillation
- Anxiety/Panic Disorders
- Shingles
- Psoriasis
- Ulcerative Colitis
- Keto Diet
- Weight Loss
- Medical Reference
- Health Education
- Disease Symptoms
- Wellness

## Medical Reference Indexes

- [Diseases & Conditions Index](https://www.medicinenet.com/diseases_and_conditions/article.htm): Comprehensive alphabetical index of medical diseases and conditions
- [Medications Index](https://www.medicinenet.com/medications/article.htm): Comprehensive drug reference with dosing, interactions, side effects
- [Procedures & Tests Index](https://www.medicinenet.com/procedures_and_tests/article.htm): Alphabetical directory of medical procedures and diagnostic tests

## Health & Wellness Guides

- [Health & Living: Information on Living a Healthy Lifestyle](https://www.medicinenet.com/health_and_living/focus.htm): Healthy lifestyle guide covering diet, fitness, nutrition, wellness
- [Diet and Weight Management](https://www.medicinenet.com/diet_and_weight_management/article.htm): Index of weight loss and weight management diet plans and nutrition
- [Exercise and Fitness](https://www.medicinenet.com/exercise_and_fitness/article.htm): Fitness and exercise guide with workout routines, tips, injury prevention
- [Nutrition and Healthy Living](https://www.medicinenet.com/nutrition_and_healthy_living/article.htm): Healthy recipes and food guides for weight loss and condition-specific diets
- [Prevention and Wellness](https://www.medicinenet.com/prevention_and_wellness/article.htm): Disease prevention and wellness guide with lifestyle and health awareness

## Educational Resources

- [Slideshows Index](https://www.medicinenet.com/slideshows/article.htm): Alphabetical index of educational medical slideshows with images
- [Quizzes Index](https://www.medicinenet.com/quizzes_a-z_list/article.htm): Alphabetical directory of health quizzes testing disease knowledge
- [Image Collections Index](https://www.medicinenet.com/image_collection/article.htm): Searchable medical images and photos of diseases and skin conditions

## Medical News & Research

- [Listening to Music for 24 Minutes May Ease Anxiety, Study Finds](https://www.medicinenet.com/listening_to_music_for_24_minutes_may_ease_anxiety/news.htm): Medical news article on music therapy benefits for anxiety relief
- [Belly Fat Linked To Heart Failure Risk](https://www.medicinenet.com/belly_fat_linked_to_heart_failure_risk/news.htm): Medical research news on belly fat and heart failure risk
- [Ultra-Processed Foods Linked To Heart Attack, Stroke, Cardiac Arrest](https://www.medicinenet.com/ultra_processed_foods_linked_to_heart_problems/news.htm): Health news on ultra-processed foods linked to cardiac events
- [Too Much Smartphone Use Linked to Disordered Eating in Teens](https://www.medicinenet.com/too_much_smartphone_use_disordered_eating_in_teens/news.htm): Health news on smartphone use linked to teen eating disorders
- [Women More Likely To Survive Cancer Than Men — At A Cost](https://www.medicinenet.com/women_more_likely_to_survive_cancer_than_men/news.htm): Medical research news on gender differences in cancer survival rates

## Featured Health Topics

- [Signs of Cancer in Women: Symptoms You Can't Ignore](https://www.medicinenet.com/womens_cancer_symptoms_pictures_slideshow/article.htm): Cancer symptom guide for women covering breast, ovarian, endometrial cancers
